mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact de Sitter background and beta stress, direct real-mode ADM scalar expansion, full nonzero-k lapse/shift/auxiliary elimination, positive reduced Q/V and energy identity, homogeneous constraints, late-time indicial controls, arbitrary-angle static principal Schur reduction/rank locus, direct cubic amplitude-envelope algebra.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic rational/surd expressions over positive K,beta,eta,gamma,H,p,a0; no sampled empirical data.
mathematics.conventions: c=1; signature (-+++); physical spatial covector P; expanding pure bare-Lambda background with S1 a0²=Lambda/(32pi); p=k/a; integrations by parts retain a³ and p-dot=-Hp.
inputs: Explicit candidate ADM action and perturbation definitions embedded in checks.py; raw_derivation.md states the mathematical interpretation.

bounds.deSitter: All positive symbolic coefficients and k>0 on exact expanding P=0 de Sitter; separately calculated k=0 homogeneous quadratic sector.
bounds.oblique: Arbitrary P components and nonzero wavevector on frozen static clock-aligned backgrounds, high-frequency principal limit only.
bounds.cubic: Envelope bound for one direct W cubic term, not complete reduced cubic action.
